CommunityApplications.Profile:
Dockyard is a minimal, self-hosted tiled launcher dashboard for your favorite Docker apps. Add tiles by hand (name, URL, icon) or pick them straight from your running containers, rearrange them by drag-and-drop, and optionally lock editing behind a password. This repository contains the single Dockyard application.
Support and bug reports: https://github.com/RayMunro/dockyard/issues
